_comment: BizHawk .bk2 movie files are the single source of truth. Each .bk2
is a self-contained zip with Input Log.txt (per-frame button bitmap)
the recording started from one). bn6f-validate reads bk2 files
directly — no pre-extracted .input or .ss derivatives needed.
This JSON catalogs the available fixtures with short descriptions.
Everything else (frame count, ROM SHA1, BIOS SHA1, etc.) lives
inside each .bk2's Header.txt and Input Log.txt and isn't duplicated

rom.game_name: Mega Man Battle Network 6 - Cybeast Falzar (USA)

fixtures.name: coldboot
fixtures.description: Cold-boot stress test. ~417 frames, zero input, no starting savestate — exercises the BIOS handoff + early ROM init paths.

fixtures.name: intro
fixtures.description: Short opening sequence (~6.2k frames, ~104s game-time). Starts from savestate — Capcom/IntSys logos + title screen.

fixtures.name: intro_to_end_tutorial
fixtures.description: Full tutorial playthrough (~16.4k frames, ~4.5min game-time). Starts from savestate. The most thorough fixture — runs through the opening battle tutorial.
